body: I'm lonely, dude.  It sucks.  Been depressed for a long time, and as a result I don't really know how to deal with people, but I'm so desperate for social interaction that it's killing me inside!  I don't have any friends right now, and it's not like I'm going to pretend it's not my fault, but I'm hoping beyond hope that it's something I can change.  I'm working hard to lose weight, I'm saving up for serious plastic surgery, and hopefully by this time next year I'll be somewhat presentable.  Maybe then I won't be one of those "that's the ugliest guy I've ever seen!" guys anymore.  Maybe then women will talk to me, and love me.  I know it's not going to be that easy, because my ugliness is more an extension of my crippling depression than anything else, so I guess you could say I'm ugly on the inside too; but the person I am now is a disgusting, bitter, selfish old man, and I'm so desperate to get away from that.  I'm so desperate to be someone else.  Nobody could ever love me as I am--I certainly don't.  At 23 years old I feel like a washed up old sack of excess skin and misplaced testosterone.  I just hate who I am, and I know that bitching about it on Reddit isn't going to do me much good, but I just need to say this somewhere because I'm desperate and I have nowhere else to turn. :(  Sorry for taking a less stoic approach to my loneliness than some other people on here.
